title: Register for a Class
description: This guide describes the published UAEU Student Registration workflow. Registration still depends on your assigned registration period, prerequisites, course load, holds, section capacity, and timetable. The assistant cannot access or submit changes to your student account.
keywords: how do I register for a course
how can I register for a course
how do I register for a class
steps to register for a course
register for a class in eservices
verificationNote: Portal labels and registration rules can change. Confirm your assigned registration period, holds, prerequisites, and the final status in eServices or with your academic advisor.

steps.title: Prepare your plan
steps.instruction: Ask your academic advisor to set the intended term's Degree Works plan to Active & Locked. Check Prepare for Registration and clear any registration holds before selecting sections.

steps.title: Open Student Registration
steps.instruction: From the UAEU website, choose Sign In, then MyUAEU > eServices > Student > Student Registration. Select Register for Classes, choose the intended term, and continue.

steps.title: Choose an available section from your plan
steps.instruction: Open Plans, find the course, choose View Sections, select an available section, and choose Add. The registration guide directs students to select from Plans rather than entering CRNs manually. A full section or timetable conflict can prevent registration.

steps.title: Submit and verify registration
steps.instruction: Add leaves the section Pending. Choose Submit, then confirm the section shows Registered and that the page reports Save Successful. Resolve any displayed registration error; a pending section is not an enrolled class.
